references.text: Warns against worshipping the sun, moon, and stars, which are the host of heaven, something forbidden by the Lord
Describes how Israel worshipped the entire host of heaven, in violation of God's command
King Manasseh worshipped the entire host of heaven and served them, an example of the idolatry that Deuteronomy warns against
Josiah removed the priests who had burned incense to the sun, moon, constellations, and the entire host of heaven
The prophet Jeremiah mentions how the people worshipped the sun, moon, and the entire host of heaven
Judgment on those who have burned incense on the rooftops to the entire host of heaven
Ezekiel sees men worshipping the sun in the Lord's temple, a serious act of idolatry
Zephaniah prophesies judgment against those who worship the host of heaven on the rooftops
Stephen quotes the prophets and mentions how Israel worshipped the host of heaven
Paul describes how people exchanged God's truth for lies and worshipped the creature rather than the Creator
